title: ORBIT 4444 deployment manifest
$comment: This portable schema enforces exact structure, scalar syntax, and contiguous transaction names. Cross-field address/hash equality and value uniqueness require the shared validateDeploymentManifestSemantics post-schema boundary.

governanceOwner.$comment: Owns the mutable modules. Optional so an existing manifest stays valid; absent means it equals owner.

transactions.$comment: The generated dependentRequired adjacency makes every accepted stepNNN key set a contiguous prefix beginning at step000 without depending on JSON property order.

moduleOwners.$comment: Each mutable module's actual owner. A single nominal owner cannot describe a partial or accepted governance handover.

modulePendingOwners.$comment: Each module's outstanding ownership nomination, or the zero address where there is none. Zero is meaningful here, so these are plain addresses.

claimPolicy.$comment: The claim policy this deployment bound and who may change eligibility. The gate address is immutable in RewardLedger, so rebinding needs a new deployment.

blockedVenues.$comment: The alternative venues this deployment blocked, each with its inventory label. Frozen at launch, so this is final for the deployment.
